dataset: Synthetic Kyiv-Pasazhyrskyi to Fastiv I single-track model
positionDefinition: Distance along an abstract track centreline from Kyiv-Pasazhyrskyi toward Fastiv I; meters. No geographic geometry or official railway chainage.
fasteningDefinition: One complete rail-to-sleeper fastening assembly per rail seat; individual clips and bolts are not separate objects. Left and right fastenings share a sleeper position; sleepers are implicit.
connectionDefinition: Every internal 25 m boundary has one connection per rail. Simulated insulated bonded joints are at 2000, 4000, 6000 m, then every 2000 m from 9000 through 63000 m; other boundaries are welds. Existing assets retain their IDs and shift by 7000 m. Joint positions are arbitrary model assumptions, not actual signal locations. Physical connection widths are abstracted.
railDefinition: position is the rail start; length is its nominal longitudinal span. The model ignores weld allowances, thermal expansion and insulating end-post thickness.
stationDefinition: Eight selected station/stop markers, not a complete list of passenger stops. Positions and 64 km endpoint distance are rounded modelling approximations, not surveyed platform positions.
scope: One linear track, two rail sides viewed toward Fastiv. No turnouts, sidings, curves, platforms, signals, crossings or overhead electrification modelled.

sources.use: Municipal description gives 57 km rail distance to Kyiv; approximate corridor scale only.
R65 continuously welded track and 1840 sleepers/km as a realistic construction basis, not a specification of this route.
Station sequence on Kyiv–Fastiv corridor; distances are model assumptions.
